title: Verify wall-frame dimensions
preconditions: Build area clear and accessible for the planned 2438.4 mm frame.

qualityChecks.instruction: Planned wall-frame length and height confirmed at 2438.4 mm against the approved dimension chain
Planned door rough opening confirmed at 952.5 mm wide and 2070.1 mm high

stopConditions: Stop if the build area cannot accept the planned 2438.4 mm frame or the approved dimensions are unavailable.

parameters.checkInstruction: Verify the build area and confirm the planned wall-frame dimensions (2438.4 mm long and high, door opening 952.5 x 2070.1 mm; flush end studs with field studs on the 16 in module; no standard spacing is claimed elsewhere) before cutting any stock.

title: Prepare frame materials and tools

qualityChecks.instruction: Frame materials and tools gathered match the preparation list

stopConditions: Stop if any listed material or tool is missing or damaged.

parameters.instruction: Gather the frame materials and tools, then check the frame dimensions and the cut list before cutting.

title: Remove temporary protection
preconditions: Materials staged away from the work area.

qualityChecks.instruction: Temporary protection panel is intact and stored flat

stopConditions: Stop if the temporary panel is damaged and cannot be stored.

parameters.note: Fold and store the protection panel for reuse.

title: Cut frame members
preconditions: Stock checked against the cut list.

qualityChecks.instruction: Every cut length is within 1.5 mm of the synthetic cut list

stopConditions: Stop if a cut length cannot be verified against the approved dimension chain.

cuts.note: Used at full board length; the doorway section is cut out after anchoring (not pre-cut).
Used at full board length (no cut).
Flush left end stud; one cut per board (93 in + kerf <= 96 in).
Common stud (16 in module); one cut per board.
Common stud (32 in module); one cut per board.
Flush right end stud; one cut per board.
King stud; one cut per board.
King stud; one cut per board.
Jack stud; offcut also yields one cripple.
Jack stud; offcut also yields one cripple.
Front 2x6 ply; both plies from one board.
In-plane racking brace; temporary, removed after inspection and stored.
Out-of-plane plumb prop; temporary, removed after inspection and stored.

title: Lay out the frame (flat)
preconditions: Cut members checked against the cut list.

qualityChecks.instruction: Stud, king, jack and cripple positions match the line-out note and the opening is 952.5 mm wide

stopConditions: Stop if the opening line-out differs from the approved 952.5 mm.

parameters.datumNote: Mark the plates flat on the floor: flush end studs at 19.05 and 2419.35 mm, common studs at 406.4 and 812.8 mm (16 in module), kings at 1187.45 and 2254.25 mm, jacks at 1225.55 and 2216.15 mm with the opening clear between 1244.6 and 2197.1 mm; header plies centred at 1720.85 mm.

title: Assemble the frame (flat)
preconditions: Members marked and laid out flat in assembly order.

qualityChecks.instruction: Two screws at every plate joint, both header plies bearing on the jacks and both cripple ends fixed; the frame is square before raising

stopConditions: Stop if a joint cannot take the two synthetic screws at the scheduled positions.

title: Raise the frame, fit the racking brace and the plumb prop
preconditions: Frame assembled square and lying flat in position.

qualityChecks.instruction: Frame raised upright; the racking brace is fixed flat to the framing and the plumb prop bears on the floor and the frame

stopConditions: Stop if the frame cannot be raised without damaging members or the slab.

parameters.datumNote: Raise the frame onto the layout line; the in-plane diagonal resists racking and the out-of-plane prop holds the frame plumb until the bottom plate is anchored. Neither temporary member is left in place.

title: Anchor the bottom plate
preconditions: Frame raised, braced and plumb; slab sound for the synthetic anchor schedule.

qualityChecks.instruction: Three anchors on permanent plate segments (152.4, 762 and 2320 mm) with 10 x 60 mm pilot holes; none inside the door opening

stopConditions: Stop if the slab cannot take the synthetic anchor pattern.

title: Open the door rough opening (cut the sole plate)
preconditions: Bottom plate anchored on permanent segments.

qualityChecks.instruction: Doorway section cut out flush with both jack studs and discarded; the remaining left and right plate segments stay anchored

stopConditions: Stop if the plate cannot be cut without damaging the jack studs or an anchor.

parameters.note: Cut the doorway section out of the anchored plate between the jack studs; the left and right remaining segments stay anchored and are represented as their own parts from this step on.

title: Inspect the frame
preconditions: Frame anchored and the doorway opened.

qualityChecks.instruction: Plumb within 3 mm, diagonals differ by <= 3 mm, opening 952.5 x 2070.1 mm, both header plies bearing on both jacks, no anchor inside the opening

stopConditions: Stop and raise an issue if plumb, square or the opening is outside the synthetic criteria.

parameters.inspectWhat: Frame plumb, square, overall size, header plies bearing, plate segments and the door rough opening
parameters.criteria: Plumb within 3 mm over the wall height; diagonals differ by <= 3 mm; framed length and height 2438.4 mm; opening clear width 952.5 mm and height 2070.1 mm; both header plies bear fully on both jack studs; the remaining plate segments stay anchored.

title: Remove the racking brace

qualityChecks.instruction: Racking brace removed and stored for reuse

stopConditions: Stop if the frame racks once the brace is released; refit it and raise an issue.

parameters.note: Store the racking brace for the next frame.

title: Remove the plumb prop
preconditions: Frame inspection recorded and the plate anchored.

qualityChecks.instruction: Plumb prop removed and stored; frame stays plumb

stopConditions: Stop if the frame moves out of plumb once the prop is released; refit it and raise an issue.

parameters.note: Store the plumb prop for the next frame.

title: Cut backing blocks
preconditions: Frame inspected; bay widths checked in the field before cutting.

qualityChecks.instruction: Block lengths match the measured bays within 1.5 mm

stopConditions: Stop if a bay width differs from the derived block length before cutting.

cuts.note: Fits the stud 2 to stud 3 bay.
Fits the stud 3 to king stud bay.

title: Position backing blocks
preconditions: Blocks cut to the derived bay lengths.

qualityChecks.instruction: Both blocks sit inside their stud bays, face flush with the stud faces

stopConditions: Stop if a block does not fit its bay without forcing.

parameters.datumNote: Block top edge 1136.6 mm above the finished floor; faces flush with the stud faces; block A in the stud 2 to stud 3 bay, block B in the stud 3 to king stud bay.

title: Fasten backing blocks (held)
holdReason: Backing fastener type, length, spacing and edge distance are not released for this synthetic fixture; only the proposed connection locations may be shown.
preconditions: Released backing fastener specification and pattern

qualityChecks.instruction: Every released fastener point driven into the studs

stopConditions: Do not drive any fastener until the connection is released.

title: Inspect backing blocks
preconditions: Backing fastened per the released specification.

qualityChecks.instruction: Block faces flush within 1.5 mm and every released fastener point driven

stopConditions: Stop if a block face is not flush or a fastener point is unresolved.

parameters.inspectWhat: Backing block flushness and fastener pattern
parameters.criteria: Faces within 1.5 mm of the stud faces; every released fastener point driven.

title: Route schematic cable

qualityChecks.instruction: Route matches the approved schematic path

stopConditions: Do not energize; this is a schematic demonstration only.

title: Cover wall
preconditions: Backing inspection accepted; cable route installed.

qualityChecks.instruction: No fasteners penetrate the backing blocks; panel against the stud faces

stopConditions: Do not cover before the backing inspection is accepted.

parameters.datumNote: Demonstration panel trimmed to the door opening, face against the stud faces.

title: Position cabinet envelope (conditional)
preconditions: Wall covering installed and inspected; backing fastening released (still held in this demonstration).

qualityChecks.instruction: Confirm the delivered cabinet model and door swing

stopConditions: Stop if the cabinet envelope cannot be placed without modifying released parts.

parameters.datumNote: After the wall covering is installed: envelope base 914.4 mm above finished floor; 609.6 wide x 609.6 deep x 812.8 high.
